reviews.text: Love this place and the staff is friendly and welcoming, big choice of cannabis, great prices, nice and safe place to spend some time and your furry friend is welcome too 😁
Awesome place great range of products, shop is amazing and staff are so friendly and helpful..would highly recommend coming here when in Kata Beach. Best place
Smoothies are great!

Love the T Bone!!!! This is real Cali quality with good price. The shop is very clean. They got  UFC6!! I spent 4 hours to get sober and what the best is the mango smoothie that you can't find anywhere. Staffs are friendly and keep my company. I really enjoy the time here while I'm in Kata. I  recommend to come check out. There are many Thai grown strains also The KRAZY Runtz mmmmmmm
Good atmosphere and chill place to be . The best quality in town . Ask for more detail to the sale .
Best place in Kata, I been in all the shops and it’s the best for the prices and quality !! Fresh buds, always got what I need there !

Місце топ, дуже дружні хлопці зустріли на вході, розповіли про асортимент, спробували їхній особистий гров, рекомендую 👍🏼
Також як бонус є така кімната для чілу, курити можна але крім папірців нічого нема в користування, але ми собі купили маленький бонг 😉 мають промо папірець, купляєш 5 - 6й рол в подарунок, теж прикольний бонус) рекомендую заклад 100%
reviews.text_en:
The place is top, very friendly guys met us at the entrance, told us about the assortment, tried their personal grill, I recommend it 👍🏼
Also as a bonus there is a room for smoking, you can smoke but there is nothing to use except for the papers, but we bought ourselves a small bong 😉 they have a promo paper, you buy the 5th - 6th roll as a gift, also a cool bonus) I recommend the establishment 100%

reviews.text: Absolute rip off.. the prices are 2-3x for low quality weed and the place smoke is so small and cramped too.. very disappointed

Absolutely loved this place. Great vibe, super friendly staff and easily one of the better cannabis spots around Kata Beach. The team were welcoming, knowledgeable and actually took the time to explain different strains rather than just pushing the most expensive options.
If you’re staying in Kata and want good quality with genuine service, I’d definitely recommend stopping by here. Will 100% be back while I’m in Phuket.
Good experience, excellent variety of choices, cool room to chill and smoke
Best shop in Kata! 100% reccomended! Friendly team, and nice smoking room! If you’re here check them out!
Great joint. Genuine product and price!
Amazing people had a great time!

Jay is very helpful and the shop is very nice.
Would recommend!
Very friendly and helpful would definitely recommend and come back.

This was our first time in Thailand and this place was walking distance from our Airbnb. Jay is AMAZING! Super friendly and accommodating. We will definitely be coming back to Good Kush bar next time we’re in Phuket!
Great shop, very friendly
Good place enjoyable person
Good selections and good prices on bulk
Great shop with extremely high quality products, price is definitely worth the smoke.
The best in town! Truly recommended :)

I came to this shop with my girlfriend. But it's so overpriced, it's a shame... They have no deals, the prices are what you see which are almost 2x compared to other places that have good deals. Wonder how they have 5 stars, it's because they give out a free "mystery" joint if you write a good review (who knows what's inside because they don't tell you). I recommend other places like Lion Rolling Circus.

Amo este lugar! Comenzando con la atención es 10/10❤️ Muy atentos y el lugar es muy bonito para y chill para fumar. Tienes flores de muy buena calidad! Si estás por phuket definitivamente tienen que visitar este lugar. Y lo mejor de todo es que tienen deals con ofertas 🫶🏻
Update: Fui de nuevo al lugar con mi novio y me atendió la misma chica. Dejamos una reseña honesta de nuestra compra y ahora nos están amenazando con la policía por “difamación”. Tengan mucho cuidado cuando vayan a este lugar, o mejor evítenlo ⚠️
reviews.text_en:
I love this place! Starting with the service, it's 10/10 ❤️ They're very attentive, and the place is really nice and chill for smoking. They have really good quality flowers! If you're in Phuket, you definitely have to visit this place. And the best part is that they have deals and offers 🫶🏻
Update: I went back to the place with my boyfriend, and the same girl served us. We left an honest review of our purchase, and now they're threatening us with the police for "defamation." Be very careful when you go to this place, or better yet, avoid it ⚠️

It’s really good and friendly place
Love this place! Friendly and great product.
